top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a complete, decades-confirmed physiological discovery: Holst on GLP-1 secretion and insulinotropic action in humans, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology and receptor action, and Mojsov on the active peptide. It is followed by randomised evidence on glycaemia, weight, cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The citation is scoped to the physiology and active form rather than a product. The contested Mojsov and Habener priority and the exclusion of Knudsen under the three-person cap are real weaknesses, but they do not outweigh the merit and maturity, so an award is preferred to no award.
